screens.title: AI is changing the pace and unit of work in risk.
screens.subtitle: Working conversation: where AI may change the risk function, which blocks to advance, and what a lean first step looks like for your context.

screens.title: Three pressures are converging.
screens.subtitle: Each pressure alone is manageable. Together they may require a different operating model.
screens.whyShown: Establishes the client context and why action may be needed now.

screens.title: Match technology to the task.
screens.subtitle: Five patterns. Each has a distinct evidence, control, and cost profile. Not every pattern is applicable to every problem.
screens.whyShown: Calibrates expectations: not all AI is equal or ready for every context.

screens.title: Find the decisions under pressure.
screens.subtitle: Select capabilities that reflect where your function feels the constraint. Your selection carries forward.
screens.whyShown: Grounds the conversation in the client's specific capability landscape.

screens.title: Choose one proof.
screens.subtitle: A working candidate set based on selected capabilities. Choose one to carry through the story.
screens.whyShown: Forces a specific, owned decision rather than abstract discussion.

screens.title: See the work move.
screens.subtitle: How the selected use case works end to end: data, automation, AI, and human gates.
screens.whyShown: Makes the abstract concrete -- shows exactly what changes in the process before the system discussion.

screens.title: The use case depends on the system.
screens.subtitle: Eight interdependent blocks. The selected use case highlights which need attention before scale.
screens.whyShown: Shows system-level dependencies -- what else needs to change beyond the use case itself.

screens.title: Start with tasks, then roles.
screens.subtitle: Illustrative impact across risk function roles. Adjust scope and adoption to reflect your context.
screens.whyShown: Addresses the workforce question before it becomes a blocker.

screens.title: Define the proof.
screens.subtitle: Seven stages from capability selection to realised value. Set the gate criteria before you start.
screens.whyShown: Shifts from conceptual to operational -- what specifically will we measure?

screens.title: Scale without multiplying complexity.
screens.subtitle: Five functional layers with cross-cutting controls. Each proof surfaces which layers need investment.
screens.whyShown: Connects the proof to the broader architecture needed for production scale.

screens.title: Control cost per successful case.
screens.subtitle: Model run cost with your volumes and operating assumptions. All defaults are illustrative.
screens.whyShown: Addresses the CFO question: what does this cost to run at scale?

screens.title: Use AI twice.
screens.subtitle: Two reinforcing engines: redesigning the client risk function while shortening delivery through reusable assets.
screens.whyShown: Differentiates Accenture: we apply AI to our own delivery, not just the client.

screens.title: Move in gates, not leaps.
screens.subtitle: A staged transition limits early commitment. Each gate tests readiness before the next investment.
screens.whyShown: De-risks the commitment decision: you do not need to commit to the full journey upfront.

screens.title: Agree the next move.
screens.subtitle: Session summary built from your selections. What have we agreed? What happens next?
screens.whyShown: Closes the conversation with a concrete, owned output.
